newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIAN PM TO VISIT FINLAND ON WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIAN PM TO VISIT FINLAND ON WEDNESDAY.

text.p: Estonian Prime Minister Mart Siimann will on Wednesday make a working visit to Finland at the invitation of Finnish Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen, the prime minister's press office said on Monday.
Siimann will meet Lipponen and Finnish President Martti Ahtisaari, the press office said in a statement.
Siimann will discuss the expansion of the European Union, European security policy, Estonian-Finnish relations and cooperation between the Baltic Sea countries, it added.
